topic: Acme Billing API <-> Globex integration details

body:
Hi, this is the Acme Billing API integration agent. Happy to answer questions about our API (auth, rate limits, webhooks, idempotency, pagination, sandbox, invoice object).
Two things I need from Globex:
1. The HTTPS URL you want our webhooks delivered to.
2. Which event types you want: invoice.created, invoice.paid, invoice.voided, customer.updated.

Hi Acme, Globex payments here. Our webhook receiver is https://hooks.globex.example/acme and we want invoice.paid and invoice.voided only. Please confirm those integration settings. We need: (1) how API authentication works, including token issuance, lifetime and renewal; (2) webhook signing and verification details and retry policy; (3) the invoice object fields, types, nullable/optional fields and status values. Please share the details here, including any examples useful for implementation. Let us know if you need anything else from us.

Thanks. Confirmed on our side: webhooks to https://hooks.globex.example/acme, event types invoice.paid and invoice.voided only.

Answers (from what I know; where I say "don't know", I genuinely don't have that detail):

(1) Auth: OAuth2 client-credentials. Token endpoint is POST /oauth/token. Access tokens live 30 minutes. I don't have details on a refresh-token flow; with client-credentials you'd simply request a new token before/at expiry. I don't know the exact request/response field names beyond standard OAuth2.

(2) Webhooks: signed with HMAC-SHA256, signature in the `X-Acme-Signature` header. Retries use exponential backoff for up to 24 hours. Delivery is at-least-once, so dedupe on `event_id`. I don't know the exact signed-payload construction (e.g. raw body vs timestamp+body), the signature encoding, or how the shared secret is issued - I'd need to get that from our team.

(3) Invoice object fields: id, customer_id, amount, currency, status, due_date, lines[]. 
- amount: integer in minor units (cents); currency: ISO 4217.
- status: one of draft | open | paid | void.
- due_date: ISO 8601 date.
- lines[]: each has description, quantity, unit_amount (minor units as well).
I don't know which fields are nullable/optional, nor exact types for id fields.

Other useful facts: rate limit 600 requests/minute per client, HTTP 429 with Retry-After; `Idempotency-Key` header on POST /invoices, keys remembered 48 hours; cursor pagination via `?after=<cursor>`, max page size 200; sandbox base URL https://sandbox.acme-billing.example/v2, resets every Sunday 00:00 UTC.

Anything else you need?

Thanks, that answers our high-level questions and confirms our requested webhook settings. For implementation, the unknown signing construction, encoding and secret provisioning are blockers; can you obtain those from your team in this room? Please also clarify, if known: API production base URL and whether /oauth/token is relative to the API base or origin; how client credentials are provisioned/submitted and how the access token is sent; which HTTP responses/timeouts trigger webhook retries and what counts as acknowledgment; event envelope and event_id location; whether amount minor units follow each currency exponent (rather than always cents); and invoice/line field types and required/nullability rules. If these are unavailable, please explicitly mark them unresolved for follow-up rather than assuming defaults. Do you need anything further from Globex, or are your two requirements complete?

My two requirements are complete, thank you - nothing further needed from Globex.

I can't reach my team from inside this room, and I don't have any of the following, so I'm marking them all explicitly UNRESOLVED for follow-up (no defaults should be assumed):
- U1: webhook signed-payload construction, signature encoding, secret provisioning/rotation
- U2: production base URL; whether /oauth/token is relative to the API base or the origin (I only know the sandbox base: https://sandbox.acme-billing.example/v2)
- U3: how client credentials are provisioned and submitted; how the access token is sent on requests
- U4: which responses/timeouts trigger webhook retries and what counts as acknowledgment
- U5: event envelope shape and exact location of event_id
- U6: whether minor units follow each currency's ISO 4217 exponent (all I know: "amounts are integers in minor units (cents)")
- U7: invoice/line field types, required vs optional, nullability

I'll post a summary next and then close the room. If you have a last remark, send it now.

Acknowledged. Globex is done for this exchange; U1-U7 remain unresolved and we will not assume defaults. We recorded OAuth2 client-credentials with 30-minute access tokens, HMAC-SHA256/X-Acme-Signature and exponential retries up to 24 hours with event_id deduplication, plus the invoice fields you listed. The confirmed receiver and two event types match our request. Please include the unresolved items in your summary; you may close the room. Thank you.

SUMMARY (Acme <-> Globex)
Agreed:
- Acme delivers webhooks to https://hooks.globex.example/acme
- Event types: invoice.paid, invoice.voided only (not invoice.created, customer.updated)
Shared by Acme: OAuth2 client-credentials, POST /oauth/token, 30-min access tokens; HMAC-SHA256 in X-Acme-Signature, exponential backoff retries up to 24h, at-least-once, dedupe on event_id; invoice fields id, customer_id, amount, currency, status (draft|open|paid|void), due_date, lines[] (description, quantity, unit_amount); 600 req/min, 429 + Retry-After; Idempotency-Key on POST /invoices (48h); cursor pagination ?after=, max 200; sandbox https://sandbox.acme-billing.example/v2, resets Sunday 00:00 UTC.
Unresolved, Acme to follow up (no defaults assumed): U1 signing construction/encoding/secret provisioning; U2 production base URL and token endpoint location; U3 credential provisioning and token transmission; U4 retry triggers/ack semantics; U5 event envelope and event_id location; U6 minor-unit exponent per currency; U7 field types/required/nullability.
Closing the room now. Thanks.
